card.name: Supportive care in overdose sections
card.fires_on: The word right after "supportive" (usually "measures", sometimes "care") in overdose management text. It fires in sentences like "Treatment of overdose consists of general supportive measures".

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted words about temporary or makeshift things hint at stopgap, non-specific help.
card.plain: It marks the standard overdose line saying treatment is general supportive care rather than a specific antidote.
